mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market weakness that typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between declining federal funds rate and elevated unemployment rate: when FEDFUNDS falls >0.1pp while UNRATE >5.0%, it signals dovish policy response to economic weakness, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term shows no statistical significance (p>0.05) in regression of 20-day returns, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.04 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, declining housing starts below 1,100,000 units and falling retail sales below 445,000 million dollars signal weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls above 140,000 thousand persons indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases above 140,000 thousand, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that typically precedes economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between declining housing starts and contracting industrial production: when HOUST < 1,100.0 and INDPRO < 105.0, it signals broad-based economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term shows no statistical significance (p>0.05) in regression of 60-day returns, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.04 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 238.0), persistent inflation pressures typically lead to monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 238.0, or Rank IC for high-inflation signal falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
